jobs.title: Cybersecurity Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.

 

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

 

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

 

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

 

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

 

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works



This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. 




SUMMARY OF HOW YOU WILL IMPACT SKYLO

Skylo is building satellite-to-device (NTN) connectivity infrastructure connecting mobile network operators worldwide. Security Operations is the most critically understaffed pillar in our InfoSec build-out relative to its 24/7 mandate, and we're hiring a Cybersecurity Manager to stand up and lead this function from the ground up — covering detection, monitoring, incident response, and threat management across our satellite network, ground infrastructure, and enterprise systems. You'll build the SOC function from scratch rather than inherit one — shaping tooling, process, and team structure for a company defining a new category of critical connectivity infrastructure.




HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Build and lead Skylo's Cyber Fusion Center function, including staffing model, shift/coverage strategy, and escalation processes for 24/7 monitoring

 - Own the SIEM/EDR/XDR stack — deployment, tuning, use-case development, and detection engineering

 - Lead incident response: triage, containment, root cause, and post-incident reporting for security events across cloud, corporate IT, data center and product environments

 - Define and mature SOC processes — runbooks, playbooks, escalation paths, and metrics (MTTD, MTTR, alert fidelity)

 - Manage and mentor SOC analysts as the team scales through phased hiring

 - Partner with Network Operation, Product Security, Cloud Security, and GRC to ensure shared visibility and coordinated response

 - Stand up a Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) capability — sourcing, curating, and operationalizing threat feeds and IOCs relevant to telco/satellite/NTN threat actors

 - Translate CTI into proactive detection content, threat hunting hypotheses, and risk briefings for leadership

 - Report SOC metrics and risk posture to Head of InfoSec and leadership; contribute to exec-level reporting

 - Support compliance evidence gathering for ISO 27001, NIS2, and other frameworks tied to detection and response controls

 - Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, FiGHT, D3FEND, IOC analysis, and threat detection.

 - Build automated/SOAR response on thematic incidents




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in security operations/incident response, with 2+ years in a SOC leadership or team-lead role

 - Hands-on experience standing up or significantly maturing a SOC function, ideally in a scaling or greenfield environment

 - Deep familiarity with SIEM/EDR/XDR platforms (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) — deployment and tuning, not just operation

 - Strong incident response fundamentals: forensics, threat hunting, containment strategy

 - Experience building or running a Cyber Threat Intelligence function — feed sourcing/curation, IOC management, and threat actor tracking relevant to critical infrastructure

 - Understanding of cyber fusion center concepts — integrating SOC, CTI, IR, and vulnerability management functions for unified detection-to-response workflows

 - Experience building 24/7 or follow-the-sun coverage models

 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to telco/critical infrastructure (ISO 27001, NIS2, SOC 2)

 - People management experience — hiring, mentoring, and scaling a technical team

 - Strong stakeholder communication — comfortable presenting risk and incident status to executive leadership

 - Bonus: experience in telco, satellite, or other regulated critical-infrastructure environments
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as: 

 - Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program 

 - Comprehensive benefits plan

 - Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement

 - A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad

 - Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service 

 - Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization 

 - Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics 
   
   
   


EEO STATEMENT

Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

 

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

jobs.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.

 

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

 

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

 

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

 

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

 

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works



 


SUMMARY OF HOW YOU WILL IMPACT SKYLO

Skylo is hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager who uses AI as a core professional skill — not just a curiosity. You'll help fulfill Skylo's vision of cellular devices roaming seamlessly across satellites, ensuring no one is ever "out of coverage" again. This is a hands-on, high-output role where you will be expected to operate with the leverage of a much larger team by deeply integrating AI tools into every facet of your work — from content creation and market research to campaign execution and partner enablement.

 


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Create high-quality content at scale — blogs, solution briefs, white papers, videos, and presentations — using AI writing and design tools to dramatically increase output velocity and quality

 - Maintain and evolve a single, consistent Skylo Voice across all content and channels, using AI tools to audit and enforce brand consistency

 - Manage the Skylo blog, website, and external communications, leveraging AI for content scheduling, SEO optimization, and performance analysis

 - Run PR campaigns and manage external PR agencies, using AI to draft, review, and optimize press materials while maintaining strict budget adherence


MARKET INTELLIGENCE & STRATEGY

 - Develop a deep, continuously updated understanding of the global NTN/satellite connectivity market using AI-powered research and competitive intelligence tools

 - Create market-specific execution plans for different regions and customer segments, informed by AI-generated insights and data synthesis

 - Rapidly synthesize analyst reports, competitor activity, and customer signals into actionable briefs using AI tools


PARTNER & CUSTOMER ENABLEMENT

 - Deliver partner enablement training, using AI to personalize content for different partner profiles and geographies

 - Build scalable enablement frameworks and assets that partners can self-serve, with AI-assisted localization and customization

 - Coordinate with global partners across time zones, using AI to streamline communication, summarization, and follow-through


CAMPAIGNS & DEMAND GENERATION

 - Execute multi-channel campaigns to target, engage, and nurture prospects, using AI to personalize outreach, optimize messaging, and analyze performance in real time

 - Oversee marketing events and strategy, using AI tools for logistics coordination, content preparation, and post-event analysis


VENDOR & OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT

 - Identify and manage external creative and marketing vendors on tight timelines, using AI to accelerate briefing, review, and feedback cycles

 - Build efficient, AI-augmented workflows that reduce operational drag and increase the team's overall throughput


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 6-8 years of relevant experience in product marketing or closely related roles, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day workflows to drive productivity and outcomes

 - You actively use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Jasper, or equivalent) in your daily workflow and can demonstrate measurably higher output as a result

 - Excellent writing and communication skills — you use AI to enhance your voice, not replace it; you know when to prompt, when to edit, and when to write from scratch

 - Proven ability to create polished collateral, presentations, and high-level designs, with or without a dedicated design team, using AI-assisted design tools (e.g., Canva AI, Adobe Firefly)

 - Experience managing external vendors and partners on fast-moving timelines in a startup environment

 - Strong attention to detail and outcomes-orientation — focused on timelines, deliverables, and measurable impact

 - Entrepreneurial spirit with the ability to adapt rapidly in a highly fluid environment

 - Ability to understand and develop execution plans for global markets across multiple time zones

 - Highly collaborative — you work well across engineering, sales, and executive teams

 - Prior experience in a B2B tech, telecom, or deep-tech startup is strongly preferred

 - Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of folding new ones into your workflow quickly



Additional information

The compensation ranges for this position is:

 - San Francisco Bay Area: $160,000 – $175,000 base salary + equity

 - Remote, U.S: $140,000 – $155,000 base salary + equity

These ranges reflects the low and high end of the range Skylo reasonably and generally expects to pay the hired candidate in this role.

SUMMARY OF HOW YOU WILL IMPACT SKYLO

Skylo is hiring a Senior Enterprise Partner Marketing Manager to turn our strategic partner relationships into measurable growth.

You'll own and execute joint go-to-market plans across a portfolio of mobile network operators (MNOs) and strategic ecosystem partners, developing programs that accelerate adoption, expand usage, strengthen partner advocacy, and drive measurable business impact.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on individual contributor role. You'll work closely with Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Communications, Product, and our partners' own marketing organizations to understand where growth is getting stuck, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and move programs from strategy through execution.

Like every role at Skylo, you'll use AI as a core professional skill. We're looking for someone who naturally uses AI and modern tools to research markets, uncover opportunities, create and personalize partner assets, analyze results, automate repetitive work, and operate with the leverage of a much larger team.




HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE


PARTNER GROWTH & JOINT GO-TO-MARKET

 - Own joint go-to-market plans across a portfolio of strategic MNO and ecosystem partners, from opportunity identification through execution and measurement.

 - Develop programs that increase partner adoption, usage, and growth, identifying where existing partnerships are getting stuck and translating those insights into actionable initiatives.

 - Work directly with partner marketing organizations to develop and execute joint launches, campaigns, customer stories, enablement, events, demand-generation programs, and other initiatives.

 - Identify opportunities to expand existing partnerships by combining partner insights, market signals, customer behavior, and Skylo's business priorities.

 - Turn ambiguous opportunities and early-stage ideas into structured programs with clear objectives, owners, timelines, and measures of success.

 - Develop repeatable partner marketing motions that can scale across Skylo's growing global ecosystem.


PARTNER & CUSTOMER ENABLEMENT

 - Build scalable partner enablement programs, frameworks, and assets that help partners successfully position, launch, and grow Skylo-enabled services.

 - Develop partner-facing presentations, solution briefs, customer stories, training materials, and other collateral, using AI tools to increase speed, personalization, and quality.

 - Adapt programs and materials for different partner profiles, markets, customer segments, and geographies.

 - Coordinate with global partners across time zones and ensure strong follow-through from planning through execution.


MARKET INTELLIGENCE & GROWTH INSIGHTS

 - Develop a deep, continuously updated understanding of the global NTN and satellite connectivity market, including partner, customer, competitor, and ecosystem developments.

 - Use data, partner feedback, customer behavior, and market signals to identify adoption barriers and new growth opportunities.

 - Rapidly synthesize analyst research, competitor activity, partner activity, and customer signals into actionable recommendations.

 - Measure partner marketing performance and use insights to determine where Skylo should invest, experiment, or adjust its approach.


CAMPAIGNS, EVENTS & ECOSYSTEM ACTIVATION

 - Develop and execute partner-focused campaigns and activations that increase awareness, adoption, engagement, and demand.

 - Represent Skylo alongside partners at key industry events and ecosystem moments, including joint launches, conferences, and partner activations.

 - Partner with internal teams and external vendors to execute programs on fast-moving timelines.

 - Measure program effectiveness and continuously improve the partner marketing playbook based on results.


AI-ENABLED EXECUTION

 - Use AI tools in your daily workflow to accelerate research, content development, analysis, partner personalization, campaign execution, and operational follow-through.

 - Experiment with new AI-enabled workflows and tools that improve the speed and quality of partner marketing execution.

 - Build efficient, AI-augmented processes that reduce operational drag and allow you to operate effectively without requiring a large team or extensive agency support.

 - Maintain strong judgment over when to use AI, when human expertise is required, and how to ensure the quality and accuracy of AI-assisted work.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 6–8+ years of relevant experience in partner marketing, ecosystem marketing, channel marketing, strategic partnerships, go-to-market, product marketing, or a closely related function.

 - Demonstrated experience developing and executing joint go-to-market programs with strategic partners or customers.

 - Track record of driving measurable partner adoption, engagement, pipeline, usage, revenue, or other business outcomes.

 - Strong commercial instincts with the ability to understand a partner's business, identify growth barriers, and translate opportunities into executable programs.

 - Experience working directly with external partner marketing, business development, sales, or product organizations.

 - Ability to take loosely defined opportunities from idea through execution and bring structure to ambiguous problems.

 - Strong cross-functional influence and stakeholder-management skills, with experience working across Sales, Partnerships, Product, Marketing, Communications, and executive teams.

 - Analytical mindset and comfort using data to diagnose problems, prioritize opportunities, and measure results.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex technical and business concepts for different audiences.

 - Resourceful, hands-on operating style with the ability to execute independently in a fast-moving environment.

 - Active use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or equivalent in day-to-day work, with the ability to demonstrate how AI has improved your productivity or outcomes.

 - Curiosity and willingness to rapidly learn and incorporate new AI tools and workflows as they emerge.

 - Experience managing external vendors and partners on fast-moving timelines.

 - Ability to develop and execute programs across global markets and time zones.

 - Prior experience in B2B technology, telecom, connectivity, cloud, hardware, or deep tech is strongly preferred.

Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active AI habits and a track record of quickly incorporating new tools into your workflow.




WHAT WE OFFER 

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we offer an attractive range of benefits:

 - Competitive compensation packages including a stock option-based equity program

 - Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement plan

 - Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement

 - A generous time-off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad

 - A once-in-a-career opportunity to operate the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network

 - Access to a world-class team across software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite, and network virtualization
